people.name: Adullam
people.line: A Canaanite city, later fortified by Judah.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Mareshah
people.line: A town in Judah; fortified by Rehoboam

translations.web: I will yet bring to you, inhabitant of Mareshah. He who is the glory of Israel will come to Adullam.
translations.bsb: I will again bring a conqueror against you, O dweller of Mareshah. The glory of Israel will come to Adullam.
translations.kjv: Yet will I bring an heir unto thee, O inhabitant of Mareshah: he shall come unto Adullam the glory of Israel.
translations.asv: I will yet bring unto thee, O inhabitant of Mareshah, him that shall possess thee: the glory of Israel shall come even unto Adullam.
